description: Zones d'Activités Économiques (ZAE) - GPS Enrichi OSM + Fibre is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap + Opérateurs Réseau Télécom. Liste des Zones d'Activités É conomiques (ZAE) sur le territoire de Grand Paris Sud issues des données Open Street Map enrichies des données opérateur de réseau fibre optique. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal shows 117 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
